snippet.title: Astral Ascent - Expedition 33: For Those Who Come After Update Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Astral Ascent: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930/Astral_Ascent/

It’s time to head back to Astral Ascent for a new collaboration with Clair Obscur: Expedition 33! Both the main cast and iconic bosses like Mimes and Pétank are joining the platformer roguelite. This free update includes 6 new summons, 3 bosses, 2 music tracks, and 3 different rooms. And yes, you can hug Esquie... of course you can!

The update is now available for FREE on Steam, Humble, Epic Games Store, GOG, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.

Astal Ascent Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930/Astral_Ascent/
